description: Change the Page data settings of an owned HTML page or site without republishing. private = each visitor reads and writes only their own entries (default); shared = everyone reads, each visitor writes their own; shared + write author = only you write. The author always reads everything. Only what `state` names changes: a named list keeps every key the call omits (`mode` and `write` included), the other lists stay; a key set to `null` returns to its default; a list set to `null` loses its declaration and becomes private; `state: null` turns page data off (entries are kept). A private list that holds visitors' entries cannot become shared, so shared -> private cannot be undone while entries exist. Returns the stored settings and each named list's mode.

manageUrl.description: The page's private management link (https://brewpage.app/manage/...#k=...); stands in for namespace, id and ownerToken.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

state.description: Settings to change, same shape as `state` on create: `{collections: {<name>: {mode, ...}}}`

name: configure_page_data
title: Change page data settings
